name: MKTG 3665
title: Digital Marketing
description: (Also offered as BADM 3665.) This course provides an introduction to digital marketing strategies. Students learn to align digital marketing strategies with companies' overall marketing goals, and to understand the major tools of digital marketing, such as web research, analytics, search engine optimization, online ads, and social media. Students gain experience developing, implementing, and evaluating digital marketing strategies.
requirement_description: MKTG 3101 or BADM 3750; open only to business majors of junior or higher status.
